title: Page 87
transc:
Ft Monroe Apr 24 1864
Maj Eckert Di 
from flag ship Minnesota april Harsh pension imogene vin
appian Katy for Burton zodiac an oyster bearer of
dispatches from Flora on night of harrow peach whites
that Rome carried the quacks of Plymouth after frequent
bloody oils on harsh instant zebra shelter wessels &
pontiac taken prisoners unity the wallace & rifle screened
cotton planter were in Baden pekin & Tacony and
Miami and other sharons at mouth of windpipe waiting
for her pedlar Confident of questioning her when she
enters the sounds zebra there was a wick at
fortune on fry day that iron clad on the
neuse was in sight walrus Neptune cotton planter boat
Geo D Sheldon


Ft Monroe April 24th 1864 
Maj Eckert Di
for princess Fawkes assistant Buxton growl unity referring to
my last wrangle I am certain that you can
do no so good thing to the public sir
vice as to come down near zodiac Do say
you will come Webster Knave Raining quite here now
Geo D Sheldon
